01 · What is different about this pickup?

Łódź Airport · LCJ

02 · How is the transfer priced?

A cross-border trip, not a local taxi fare

The journey may involve EU/Belarus border controls and changing restrictions. The driver, vehicle, crossing, duration and availability cannot be guaranteed before confirmation.

Prices are on request: the quote reflects pickup point, exact drop-off, date, passengers, baggage and requested car. Confirm payment currency, waiting and cancellation conditions before agreeing.

Frequently asked questions

Can I book Łódź Airport to Minsk with a fixed fare?+

The price is quoted for the exact trip and agreed before confirmation. There is no published universal fixed fare for this origin.

Is pickup from Łódź Airport guaranteed?+

No. We first check whether a suitable vehicle and legally permitted international route are available on your date.

Can I request child seats or a larger car?+

Yes. Include children's ages, adults, suitcases and the preferred vehicle model in the enquiry.
